note: notes/industry/industry_exposure.csv in the Hormuz Flow repo (Eileen), each with its source; collected 2026-10-24.

rows.name: Airlines
rows.measure: fuel share of operating costs (IATA forecast; 25.4 in 2025)

rows.name: Container shipping
rows.measure: bunker share of Maersk shipping operating costs (22 a year earlier)

rows.name: Trucking
rows.measure: fuel share of operating cost per mile ($0.482 of $2.336; share computed by us)

rows.name: Cement and minerals
rows.measure: energy inputs as share of revenue (input-output table)

rows.name: Chemicals
rows.measure: energy inputs as share of revenue (input-output table)

rows.name: Manufacturing (average)
rows.measure: energy inputs as share of revenue (input-output table)

rows.name: Fishing
rows.measure: fuel share of total costs (EU fleet average; up to about 50% for trawlers)
rows.source: STECF 18-07: The 2018 Annual Economic Report on the EU Fishing Fleet (JRC)

rows.name: Farming (fuel)
rows.measure: share of total farm production expenses
rows.source: USDA NASS 2012 Census of Agriculture (Ag Atlas map 12-M062)

rows.name: Construction (steel)
rows.measure: all installed steel as share of total building cost (range 14-16% for a structural steel building; structural steel alone 9-10%)

rows.name: Drinks cans (aluminium)
rows.measure: aluminium metal as share of a can body production cost (78% for a can end; old study)
rows.source: Michigan State University thesis on aluminium can production costs

rows.name: Plastic packaging (resin)
rows.input: polymer resin and other raw materials
rows.measure: raw materials as share of selling price for European plastics converters (resin is most of it; an upper bound for resin alone; old figure)

rows.name: Textiles (power)
rows.measure: power as share of primary textile manufacturing cost (sample average; 30-40% in India; Pakistan; China; Indonesia; Brazil; 9% in the US)
